notes.title: Huge update!
notes.notes:
Some of the changes made on this update:

- Textures changes
- Remade some of the objects and/or retextured
- Worked on the enemy ai 
He can now see you and is not entirely focused on the distance between him and you. He can also hear the player.
- Added some new animations
- Worked on the UI
and many more.
- Added sprint bar
- You can now crouch
